title: Ambiance exercise and step 16 of controlled remote viewing training

tellings.quote:
We have a thing called the ambiance
exercise.

plain: Controlled remote viewing, a trained method for trying to describe distant places or hidden targets using only the mind, includes a drill called the ambiance exercise, according to Lyn Buchanan, a former Army sergeant who did the work himself. Buchanan describes it as part of the training, tied to step 16 of the method. He gives it as an insider's account of how the skill was taught.
